claim: The owner rejected a locomotive made of one texture and asked that textures and decal combinations be studied in other levels' locomotives. So a built object (locomotive, ship, machine, statue) is made as several surfaces by role plus decal sprites, taken from Blood's own instance of it. E1M4's engine wears 255 on its body, 2453 where it is round and 438 on a top, with sprites for the wheels (2322), a flame (3566) and smokes (754, 672); the riveted underframe plate 470 is TEDE1M7's, not E1M4's.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-18: 'Locomotive is made from one texture and there is grave on it. You should study more textures, decals combinations and locomotives in other levels.' (knowledge/blood/studies/locomotive/notes.md:5)
use: Walk round Blood's instance with look_at and write its recipe before building.
